def decide(bars, account):
    """Trend-follow with a permissive entry: hold while the 20-day MA leads the 50-day MA; exit on a 20-day break or hard stop."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 55:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history"
    price = closes[-1]
    ma20 = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    ma20_prev = sum(closes[-25:-5]) / 20
    ma50 = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50
    ma50_prev = sum(closes[-55:-5]) / 50
    rising20 = ma20 > ma20_prev
    rising50 = ma50 > ma50_prev
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if ma20 > ma50 and rising50 and price > ma50:
            return "BUY", "20-day MA above rising 50-day MA with price above the mean"
        return "HOLD", "no entry: trend not confirmed"
    entry = account.get("entry_price")
    if entry is not None and price < entry * 0.88:
        return "SELL", "hard stop: 12% below entry"
    if price < ma20 and not rising20:
        return "SELL", "close below 20-day MA and 20-day MA falling"
    return "HOLD", "uptrend intact"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Hold while close is above a rising 50-day average; exit when trend breaks."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 55:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 50-day average"
    price = closes[-1]
    ma50 = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50
    ma50_prev = sum(closes[-55:-5]) / 50
    rising = ma50 > ma50_prev
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if price > ma50 and rising:
            return "BUY", "close above a rising 50-day average"
        return "HOLD", "no entry: trend not confirmed"
    if price < ma50 or not rising:
        return "SELL", "close below 50-day average or average turning down"
    return "HOLD", "uptrend intact"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Seed strategy: hold the stock while its close is above the 20-day average."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 20:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 20-day average"
    average = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    price = closes[-1]
    if account["position"] <= 0 and price > average:
        return "BUY", "close is above the 20-day average"
    if account["position"] > 0 and price < average:
        return "SELL", "close is below the 20-day average"
    return "HOLD", "no change"
